55def _next_pow2(value): 

56 """Smallest power of two >= ``value`` (``tl.arange`` requires a power of two).""" 

57 return 1 << (value - 1).bit_length()

60def _resolve_sum_s(offsets): 

61 """Return the total packed length ``S = offsets[-1]`` with cache reuse.""" 

62 try: 

63 version = offsets._version 

64 except RuntimeError: 

65 # Inference tensors do not track a version counter. 

66 return int(offsets[-1].item())

69 if cached is not None and cached[0] == version: 

70 return cached[1] 

71 

72 S = int(offsets[-1].item()) 

73 _SUM_S_CACHE[offsets] = (version, S) 

74 return S

77@triton.jit 

78def _pack_row_body( 

79 padded, 

80 offsets, 

81 output, 

82 work_id, 

83 T: tl.constexpr, 

84 IB: tl.constexpr, 

85 IN: tl.constexpr, 

86 S, 

87 BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr, 

88): 

89 """Copies the ``length * IN`` contiguous segment of one work item ``(b, ib)`` into values. 

90 

91 ``work_id`` encodes both the outer batch index ``b`` and the middle-dim index ``ib``, so the 

92 source base ``work_id * T * IN`` is still a row-major contiguous segment; the destination base 

93 is computed as ``values[ib, offsets[b] + 0:length]``. ``BLOCK_SIZE`` is already sized to the 

94 full row width, so normally the inner loop runs exactly once. 

95 """ 

96 b = work_id // IB 

97 ib = work_id % IB 

98 

99 start = tl.load(offsets + b) 

100 end = tl.load(offsets + b + 1) 

101 length = end - start 

102 

103 total = length * IN 

104 src_base = work_id * T * IN 

105 dst_base = (ib * S + start) * IN 

106 

107 for i in tl.range(0, total, BLOCK_SIZE): 

108 offs = i + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE) 

109 mask = offs < total 

110 val = tl.load(padded + src_base + offs, mask=mask) 

111 tl.store(output + dst_base + offs, val, mask=mask)

128 """Pack a padded tensor into the flat `values` of a nested tensor. 

129 

130 The padded tensor is viewed as ``[B, IB, T, IN]`` where ``B`` is the 

131 outermost batch dimension, ``T`` is the padded ragged dimension, ``IB`` is 

132 the product of the intermediate batch dimensions (between the outer batch 

133 dim and the ragged dim) and ``IN`` is the product of the inner dimensions 

134 following the ragged dim. One work item ``(b, ib)`` copies the 

135 ``length * IN`` contiguous real elements from ``padded[b, ib, 0:length]`` to 

136 ``output[ib, offsets[b] + 0:length]``. 

137 

138 Grid is fixed at ``min(NUM_PROG, WORK)`` and each program walks several ``(b, ib)`` items with 

139 a work stride loop (first lever: a fixed grid keeps all 48 SPs busy, avoiding a too-small 

140 grid for small batches and idle programs for large ones). ``BLOCK_SIZE`` is the power of two 

141 covering a whole ``T * IN`` row (host-side ``_MAX_TILE_ELEMS`` caps it), so each transfer is 

142 close to one large DMA instead of many 2KB DMAs. 

143 """ 

144 pid = tle.program_id(axis=0) 

145 

146 for work_id in tl.range(pid, WORK, NUM_PROG): 

147 _pack_row_body(padded, offsets, output, work_id, T, IB, IN, S, BLOCK_SIZE)
